title: EDI: Experimental Design and Inference
description: EDI (Experimental Design and Inference) marries randomized experimental designs, both fixed (block, stratified, matched-pair, cluster, factorial, rerandomization, and MILP-based optimal designs) and sequential (matching-on-the-fly and covariate-adaptive designs: Atkinson, Efron, Pocock-Simon, urn), with inference procedures (exact, asymptotic, distribution-free, and resampling-based) matched to each design and response type: continuous, incidence, count, proportion, survival with censoring, and ordinal. Core estimation kernels are written in C++ (Eigen + LBFGS++), with both an R package (EDI) and a Python package (edi_kernels) built on the shared core.
